text:
PowerStation | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection checklist I1, to be performed 
after 
normal shutdown
as indicated in the title block
The first draft initiated by eng. Adel 
Abdel Aziz, tested by eng. Abdelel Meneim Ibrahem Haikal at 16 June 2002, 
reviewed by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Abd El-Momem El-Emam, 
accepted by general director eng. Yousry Abd El-Maksuod, and approved by eng. 
Mostafa Allam head sector of Talkha PS
Safety Precautions
Unit must be shutdown.
Work order must be issued
Wear your safety helmet, shoes ... etc
Tools and Equipment
2 Spanner 25 mm
2 Gasket
Sand paper (fine)
Work to be Carried Out
Check the spark plug assembly for freedom from binding.
Check that the electrode in a good condition by pulling smooth the the top of 
 electrode its self (take care not to pull from the cable)
Check the leakage of hot gases.
Check the HV cable for good connection.
